content.short: Blockchair is a universal privacy-respecting block explorer supporting 46 blockchains in 20 languages with comprehensive API access including Mantle.
content.description: Blockchair is a blockchain data platform available, supporting 46 different blockchain networks in 20 languages with cross-chain search functionality enabling users to look up transactions, addresses, and blocks across multiple networks simultaneously. The platform emphasizes user privacy and provides extensive API access for developers building analytics or compliance applications. Blockchair is an officially recognized data provider for the Mantle Network.
content.meta: Blockchair is a universal block explorer for 46 blockchains including Mantle with full API access. Discover Blockchair on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
